subject.title: feature request: add more metric options for "show most-used provider"

question: Should CodexBar add token or spend ranking for the unified most-used-provider icon, and what comparison window and missing-data fallback should each metric use?
rationale: The available provider snapshots are not uniformly comparable or present, so implementation cannot establish truthful ranking semantics without maintainer intent.

options.title: Keep current ranking
options.body: Retain closest-to-rate-limit ranking within the Overview subset and close the broader metric request as not planned.

options.title: Define narrow metric modes
options.body: Approve specific comparable windows and fallback behavior, then add a single metric preference that reuses Overview eligibility.

options.title: Design custom criteria
options.body: Pursue a broader user-defined ranking system with additional settings, persistence, and maintenance complexity.

recommendation.title: Keep current ranking
recommendation.body: Retain closest-to-rate-limit ranking within the Overview subset and close the broader metric request as not planned.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner already framed the unresolved contracts and selected the narrower current behavior.
